text_block_list.text:
Passing by the dance studio, I spotted 
Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't yell so loud! I'm recording a 
video here~!

Saying that, she went over to stop the 
smartphone that had been recording.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can just cut out the parts with 
voices. I'll post it later.
choice_data_list:
I thought you were practicing for the live 
show.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I heard she's filming something to upload 
to Umatok.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, I guess you could call it 
practice? Can't be showing off uncool 
dance moves, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There are so many amazing girls, and 
everyone's super cute!
choice_data_list: Jordan's good at it too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There are so many amazing girls, and 
everyone's super cute!
choice_data_list: Jordan's good at it too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, don't just go picking fights on your 
own. That's not what this is about.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't the way you put that kinda, 
you know? How should I say, uh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No, it's nothing at all! Alright, 
tour's over! Get out!!"

Afterward, I heard "Just you watch!" 
coming from behind us... but I decided not 
to tell her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Where is this coming from all of a 
sudden? I don't need any flattery, y'know.
choice_data_list: I'm not trying to flatter you, though.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, stop it, stop it! Cut that out 
already! Come on, you're making things 
weird!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, look the other way for a sec! I 
can't focus!

Despite all her loud complaining, Tosen 
Jordan continued to show off her 
razor-sharp dance moves.
